title: Live Nation Presale Opens for Bad Bunny's Barcelona Debut — European Leg of Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour Launches May 22
detail: The Live Nation exclusive presale for Bad Bunny's two sold-out Barcelona shows — May 22 and May 23, 2026 at Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys — opened on LiveNation.es on May 8, 2026 at 1:00 PM local time. General public on-sale follows May 9 at 12:00 PM. The Barcelona dates mark the opening of the European leg of the Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour, which follows the critically acclaimed and record-breaking North American and Latin American legs. Both nights at the Estadi Olímpic — the iconic venue that hosted the 1992 Barcelona Olympics — were confirmed sold-out ahead of the presale announcement. The European tour continues with Lisbon (May 28–29, Estádio da Luz) and Madrid (June 4–5, Estadio Santiago Bernabéu) among other dates. The tour is in support of *Debí Tirar Más Fotos*, the Grammy Award for Album of the Year winner that has produced 'DtMF,' the all-time Hot Latin Songs record-holder at 57 consecutive weeks at No. 1.
